prompt: Create a saved comparison of glucose between CHO-004-R01 and CHO-004-R02 and summarize the numerical result. Use exact matching elapsed sample times and define differences as CHO-004-R02 minus CHO-004-R01. Report the mean signed difference, largest absolute difference, its elapsed time in hours, and name both batches. Include the deliveries still in review and state their provisional status.

output.content:
The saved comparison is complete and stored in Work. Comparing glucose (g/L) between **CHO-004-R01** and **CHO-004-R02** at exactly matching elapsed sample times (11 matched pairs, 0–142 h), with differences defined as CHO-004-R02 minus CHO-004-R01:

- **Mean signed difference: −0.239 g/L** (R02 lower than R01 on average; standard deviation 0.324 g/L, descriptive only — successive samples of one run are not independent, so no significance test applies)
- **Largest absolute difference: 0.944 g/L at 19.5 h**, where R01 read 7.133 g/L and R02 read 6.189 g/L (R02 the lower)
- Both batches came from the Northfield Biologics October delivery; CHO-004-R01 has one extra sample at 164.0 h with no R02 counterpart (11 of 12 R01 samples matched).

**Provisional status:** all values are from deliveries still in review — read from the delivery files and not yet verified; this comparison used unreviewed values by your choice. Three deliveries are in review: Harborview CDMO fed-batch runs (6 batches), Northfield October runs (6 batches, source of these two), and Northfield November runs (6 batches). None were accepted on a reviewer's behalf. A reviewer's sign-off on the October delivery is what would settle the provisional status.
